title: National Camp Begins for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted an Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This notification impacts the composition and prospects of India's women's doubles contingent for the World Junior Championships.
summary: A change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been announced.

title: Indian Junior Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's promising U17 and U15 players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships.
summary: The Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
